Ork: Animated Minotaur by vsify, CGTrader Royalty Free License (no AI).

Incorporated game data only; original FBX and texture source files are not distributed.
Original body, clothing, skin and six native actions converted for Emberfall.

Runeforged Colossus: Icebronze - Golem by melikovfuad7, CGTrader Royalty Free License (no AI).
https://www.cgtrader.com/free-3d-models/character/fantasy-character/icebronze
Original mesh, base color, skin, idle and anima takes retained; unused DCC controllers removed.
The three attack styles reuse the original anima gesture with Emberfall effects.
The package has no native death take: a held native pose uses game-authored crystal shatter/dissolve.
Incorporated game data only; original source files are not distributed or used for model training.

Veyr the Mindbreaker: Demon Creature with Weapon - 25 animations, 2 skins by andriichykrii.
https://www.cgtrader.com/free-3d-models/character/fantasy-character/demon-creature-with-weapon-25-animations-2-skins
CGTrader Royalty Free License (no AI). Original body, orb weapon, default color maps and rig retained.
Twenty-six source takes inspected, including the A-pose. Ten runtime clips retain reviewed single-cycle
windows for idle, walking, running, three strikes, two casts, damage and death. Ground effects and lair by Emberfall.
Incorporated game data only; original FBX and texture archives are not distributed or used for model training.

Xalith the Broodmother: Insectoid Monster Rig by DM-913 (SuperKapoo913), CC BY 4.0.
https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/insectoid-monster-rig-01323e4b2563430f9da85cd255b6e176
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
Original BOOG geometry, body/wing color maps and rig converted from the owner-supplied Bugoid2.blend.
Curved B-bone segments baked for the game renderer; textures atlased, scale and skinning adapted.
The source contains one landing/settling take and one static pose. Idle, walk, run, left/right
scythe strikes, hit reaction and death are new Emberfall-authored motions on the original rig.
Cavern scenery, gameplay, warning timing and effects by Emberfall. No artist endorsement implied.

Varkesh the Blightwing: Prowler Dragon Variant Rig by DM-913, CC BY 4.0.
https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/prowler-dragon-variant-rig-7ee71aaf323d426bbbdf28d73d55bbd9
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
Original DragoTST.blend and its supplied texture maps provided by the owner.
Changes: curved Blender bones baked into runtime skin segments; preserve-volume
stance compensated for linear skinning; original color and alpha maps atlased.
The complete native Walk Loop supplies locomotion, retimed for running.
Idle, fangs, breath, hit reaction and collapse are Emberfall-authored motions.
The original model and rig are retained; full Blender PBR is not reproduced.
